review.purpose_and_scope: A separate static delivery/status page and captures can make existing results and next steps visible without changing the product workflow, execution runner, or frozen contracts.
review.status_truth: progress.json has 16 stage records; exactly V0 and V1 have status=verified. The 2/16 (12.5%) figure is therefore supported as an unweighted stage count. It must not be described as effort completion or as H2/full acceptance.
review.delivered_flows: Iteration 01 is the design explorer and synthetic replay. Iteration 02 is local synthetic-OIDC/mock-profile request registration and PostgreSQL persistence. Neither is real job execution or final acceptance.
review.next_demo: Persisted request admission with the same run/receipt and QUEUED state, including normal, duplicate, authorization-error, and reload behavior; it remains pending.
review.privacy_and_provenance: Existing delivery captures may be reused only with their capture date labeled. Keep private/raw execution evidence and original uploads out of the public page. Show direct links to the reviewed status/evidence documents.
review.validation_scope: The plan's desktop/mobile rendering, links/images, overflow, page errors, external requests, visible count reconciliation, and existing-link regression are bounded and suitable for this static page.

required_display_boundaries: Do not present synthetic replay, persisted request creation, or accepted synthetic runner units as actual execution.
Do not imply that a page or screenshot closes any of the three attempt-02 blockers or authorizes fresh490 execution.
Keep full H2, H3-H7, original AT acceptance, and the complete workflow explicitly pending.
review_method: Read-only review of the plan, progress stage statuses, iteration delivery summaries, and exact attempt-02 finding identifiers. No product changes or runtime execution.
